opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (Scheme B); up to £750 for Adelphi co-sponsored award; up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members (within six years of PhD viva) for Scheme A; PhD and postdoctoral members (within six years) for Schemes B & C; UK‑based members for overseas conferences and non‑UK members for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at Genetics Society meetings, SIG meetings, and other genetics‑related conferences, including travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK‑based course. Students need a supervisor letter; members must have at least one year membership (unless student).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to attend short training courses or collaborative visits to learn specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor letter; members need at least one year membership (unless student).
opportunities.summary: Supports travel, accommodation, subsistence and consumables for field‑based genetic research projects that aim for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Typically £1,000–£2,000; up to several thousand for major sponsorship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society (any career stage).
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, covering venue, travel, accommodation and related costs, with a requirement to include a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members wishing to run a regular series of meetings on a specific genetics theme.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £2,000 annually to support regular meetings of a new or existing Special Interest Group, covering speaker travel, accommodation, publicity and related costs.
